templates.name: 3D Product Hero — GLB Real Model
templates.description: Hero section with a real 3D GLB model, RoomEnvironment PBR lighting, UnrealBloom, and scroll-reactive camera.
templates.prompt:
Build a stunning hero section for {{CLIENT_NAME}} ({{CLIENT_SECTOR}}). Brand colors: {{CLIENT_COLORS}}. Font: {{CLIENT_FONT}}.

Hero layout: LEFT column = large headline '{{CLIENT_HERO_HEADLINE}}' + tagline '{{CLIENT_TAGLINE}}' + CTA button '{{CLIENT_CTA_PRIMARY}}' and ghost button '{{CLIENT_CTA_SECONDARY}}' + 3 stat chips ({{CLIENT_USP_1}}, {{CLIENT_USP_2}}, {{CLIENT_USP_3}}). RIGHT column = full Three.js canvas.

Three.js setup (REQUIRED):
- importmap three@0.158.0 ES modules
- Load GLB: {{CLIENT_PRODUCT_URL}} with GLTFLoader
- RoomEnvironment + PMREMGenerator for IBL lighting
- ACESFilmicToneMapping + SRGBColorSpace + antialias
- UnrealBloomPass (threshold:0.85, strength:0.4, radius:0.4)
- OutputPass
- Model auto-rotates Y-axis slowly, mouse moves cause subtle pitch/yaw tilt (lerp 0.04)
- Dark background, no basic geometry placeholders

Design: {{CLIENT_TONE}} aesthetic. Dark theme. Space Grotesk 900 weight for headlines. Zero placeholders, 100% real.

sector_variants.restaurant: Replace GLB with a plate/food product mesh. Use warm amber (#f59e0b) primary. Video background with food footage.

templates.name: Explode View 3D Disassembly Scroll
templates.description: Apple/Dyson-style explode view where a 3D model disassembles as the user scrolls. Mesh traverse with offset vectors.
templates.prompt:
Build an Apple/Dyson-style explode view section for {{CLIENT_NAME}}'s product: {{CLIENT_PRODUCT}}.

Load GLB: {{CLIENT_PRODUCT_URL}} using GLTFLoader.
model.traverse(child => if child.isMesh: meshes.push(child))
compute explode offset: child.getWorldPosition(v); dir = v.clone().normalize(); dir.multiplyScalar(2.8)

ScrollTrigger 400vh pin:
- scrub: 1.4
- onUpdate: mesh.position.lerpVectors(origPos[i], explodedPos[i], t)
- act 0–30%: model enters from below (y: -6 → 0)
- act 30–70%: explode t goes 0→1 (parts separate)
- act 70–100%: camera orbits around exploded state

SVG label overlay: project3DToScreen per mesh, draw connecting lines and spec labels.
Spec labels for {{CLIENT_PRODUCT}}: use REAL specs from client brief.

Design: {{CLIENT_COLORS}}, dark background, {{CLIENT_FONT}}, {{CLIENT_TONE}} tone.
